title: Analysis of Patients with Prescribed Hospital Admission in German Emergency Departments – An Analysis from the AKTIN Registry
summary: Patients are referred by their attending physician when the physician determines that hospital treatment is required. Nevertheless, many of these patients are discharged directly from the emergency department. Using data from the AKTIN Emergency Department Registry, we are attempting to trace the pathway of these patients.

interventions.name: A retrospective analysis of all patients presenting to multiple emergency departments with a physician referral.
